description.en: The instance type of the instance.

description.zh:
实例的数据库类型，取值说明：
- **normal**：副本集实例。
- **sharding**：分片集群实例。
description.en:
The architecture of the instance. Valid values:

- **normal**: replica set instance

- **sharding**: sharded cluster instance
The major engine version of the instance.

description.zh:
付费类型，取值说明：
- **PrePaid**（默认值）：包年包月。
- **PostPaid**：按量付费。
description.en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

- **PrePaid** (default): subscription

- **PostPaid**: pay-as-you-go

description.zh: 地域ID。您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~61933~~)接口进行查询。
description.en: The ID of the region. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~61933~~) operation to query the latest available regions.

description.zh: 节点数，只适用于副本集。
description.en: The number of nodes, only applicable to replica sets.
The ID of the resource group.

description.zh:
存储类型，取值说明：
- local_ssd：SSD本地盘。
- cloud_essd1：ESSD PL1云盘。

- cloud_essd2：ESSD PL2云盘。

- cloud_essd3：ESSD PL3云盘。
- cloud_auto：AutoPL 云盘。

默认为空，表示查询所有存储类型。
description.en:
The storage type of the instance. Valid values:

- local\_ssd: local SSD

- cloud\_essd1: PL1 enhanced SSD (ESSD)

- cloud\_essd2: PL2 ESSD

- cloud\_essd3: PL3 ESSD

- cloud\_auto: ESSD AutoPL disk

This parameter is empty by default, which indicates all types of storage resources are queried.

description.zh: 可用区ID。您可以通过[DescribeRegions](~~61933~~)接口查看可用的可用区。
description.en: The ID of the zone. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~61933~~) operation to query the available zones.

title.zh: 查询指定可用区的资源信息

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dds describe-available-resource --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zone-id cn-hangzhou-h --instance-charge-type PrePaid --db-type sharding --resource-group-id rg-acfmyiu4ekp0000 --storage-type local_ssd --db-instance-class dds.mongo.standard --engine-version 5.0 --replication-factor 3 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dds DescribeAvailableResource --region cn-hangzhou --StorageType local_ssd --EngineVersion '5.0' --ZoneId 'cn-hangzhou-h' --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmyiu4ekp0000' --ReplicationFactor 3 --DBInstanceClass 'dds.mongo.standard' --InstanceChargeType PrePaid --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DbType sharding
